messages.subject: [R-sig-Fedora] Copr for rdevel
messages.body_plain:
Not a request to implement but an enquiry as to feasibility. Would it be feasible to have a copr repo that tracks rdevel and updates dailyish (perhaps more frequently if appropriate)?

If so, and before I add it to my list of things I probably won?t get to, are there any particular gotchas/snags to be aware of?

Cheers

Tim
